task.title: Applying a Color Correction Filter
task.shortdesc: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and color balance of a source.

step.cmd: Right-click the source and choose Filters.
Under Video Filters, click + and choose Color Correction.
Adjust Gamma, Contrast, Brightness, and Saturation to taste.
Use the color wheel to shift overall color tint.

taskbody.result: Changes apply live in the preview.
